source_bin_policy: Preserve every original bin; joint weak bins remain joint, without averaging or within-bin potency ranking.

similarity_policy.interpretation: Pinned structural audit uses chirality; primary model inputs are nonisomeric/achiral. Bands do not use recomputed alternative similarities.

validation_optimization_seed_variation.metric: Best-epoch validation average precision per optimization seed
validation_optimization_seed_variation.interpretation: Optimization variability on reused validation data; not test performance or a confidence interval. Distinct from scaffold bootstrap uncertainty.

test_optimization_seed_variation.metric: Final-test average precision per selected optimization seed
test_optimization_seed_variation.interpretation: Descriptive variation across all three preselected seeds, without seed selection. Mean seed AP differs from AP of mean probabilities. This is not scaffold-bootstrap uncertainty.

limitations: Descriptive post-score summaries only; no tuning, significance tests or causal/mechanistic attribution.
One held-out patent family; source, chemistry, time and assay protocol remain confounded.
Small or single-class strata do not support ranking comparisons; AP is null unless both classes occur.
Nonisomeric collisions describe representation ambiguity; they do not establish stereochemical biology or exclude assay noise.
Descriptor summaries repeat the same parents across models; model-parent rows are not independent compounds.
